account.riskPolicy: existing BOO risk-policy/risk-budget plus operator-tightened limits

candidates.name: PULLBACK_SELLER_EXHAUSTION
candidates.hypothesis: Continuation quality improves when absolute seller notional and downside range fade through a reference-preserving pullback before a buyer-led break.
rules: use five fully completed 1m bars ending at the original trigger
among the first four bars, at least two close down and the final down-bar seller quote is below the first down-bar seller quote
sum of ranges in bars 3-4 is below bars 1-2 and all pullback closes hold signal reference
trigger closes above all four pullback highs with taker-buy quote ratio >= 0.55

candidates.name: VOLUME_DRYUP_REACCELERATION
candidates.hypothesis: A positive impulse followed by lower-volume, narrower consolidation and renewed volume identifies fresh continuation rather than exhausted chasing.
rules: use six fully completed 1m bars: three impulse, two pullback, one trigger
impulse advances; pullback mean quote volume is below impulse mean and pullback range is smaller
both pullback lows hold signal reference
trigger quote volume exceeds 1.25x pullback mean, closes above both pullback highs, and taker-buy quote ratio >= 0.55

candidates.name: BUYER_NOTIONAL_ESCALATION
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing absolute buyer notional across completed bars is more informative than a static buyer ratio for distinguishing real demand from low-volume ratio noise.
rules: use four fully completed 1m bars ending at the original trigger
absolute taker-buy quote increases strictly in every bar
trigger seller quote does not exceed the maximum of the prior three bars and all closes hold signal reference
trigger closes above all prior highs, in the upper 35% of its range, with taker-buy quote ratio >= 0.55

holdoutPolicy: Do not open walk-forward or reserved holdout unless a preregistered candidate passes every development gate.
